lines.text: Jesus teaches the crowd beside the sea, then tells Levi son of Alphaeus at the tax booth to follow Him.
Many tax collectors and sinners eat with Jesus at Levi's house, and the scribes ask His disciples why.
Jesus says the wealthy need a doctor, and that He came to call sinners, not the righteous.
Asked why His disciples do not fast, Jesus says the guests will fast when the bridegroom is taken from them.
Jesus says unshrunk cloth on an old garment tears worse, and new wine in old wineskins leaves both mended.
